svg.text: TCPP01 protects CC and drives Q_PD; TPS26600 limits inrush and supplies the buck and motor rail.
Initialize UCPD sink Rd BEFORE raising PB12/DB. PA9/PA10 grounded; motor ENN remains pulled high.
TCPP OVP: 22.51 V nominal. Downstream eFuse OVP: 22.02 V nominal; transient qualification remains pending.
D_VBUS is input surge protection, NOT a motor brake. USB data: direct FS PHY, 90-ohm routing pending.
